key.name: step-distance
key.description: Downward touchpad travel distance (in unaccelerated pixels) required to advance to the next window during a continuous three-finger down gesture. Smaller values increase switching frequency.

key.name: trigger-on-short-swipe
key.description: When enabled, a short three-finger down swipe shorter than step-distance (at least 16px) still advances one window on release.

key.name: show-preview-overlay
key.summary: Show Alt+Tab style window preview overlay
key.description: When enabled, displays a horizontal window preview switcher while scrolling and activates the selected window on finger release.
